# How does HAAS Alert handle data privacy and security?[Print Article](https://support.haasalert.com/help/how-does-haas-alert-handle-data-privacy-and-security\# "Print Article")[Email Article](https://support.haasalert.com/help/how-does-haas-alert-handle-data-privacy-and-security\# "Email Article")



06/04/2026 7:32 am CDT


At HAAS Alert, data privacy and security are foundational to the services we provide. Our Safety Cloud® platform is designed to securely manage, transmit, and store vehicle and roadway data, ensuring that sensitive information is protected at all times.

We maintain a comprehensive set of privacy, security, and compliance controls to meet the needs of our partners, including public safety agencies, municipal agencies, fleets, and technology partners. Here are the key ways we safeguard your data:

## Data Privacy

- Minimal Data Collection: HAAS Alert collects only the data necessary to power digital alerting and Safety Cloud services—such as location, heading, and basic vehicle telemetry. We do not collect personal driver data or unrelated vehicle information.

- Anonymized Usage: Data is anonymized where appropriate and used solely to enhance roadway safety and support alerting services.

## Data Security

- Secure Transmission: All data transmitted between vehicles, devices, and our cloud infrastructure is encrypted in transit using industry-standard protocols (e.g., HTTPS, TLS).

- Secure Storage: Data is encrypted at rest and in transit (TLS) using AES-256 encryption within secure cloud environments.

- Access Controls: Strict access controls ensure that only authorized personnel can access sensitive systems and data.

## Compliance & Certifications

- SOC 2 Types I, II, III Compliance: HAAS Alert adheres to SOC 2 Type II requirements, which verify the operational effectiveness of our data controls and security processes.
- ISO/IEC 27001: Our services comply with the international standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS).
- ISO 9001: Our processes are aligned with the ISO 9001 standard for quality management systems and continuous improvement.
- GDPR: We are fully compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for the processing and storage of personal data of EU-based users.
- Regulatory Alignment: Our services align with data governance requirements in the United States and other global jurisdictions where applicable, including compliance with FCC, CE, and RCM standards.


## Transparency & Trust Center

For a detailed overview of our security policies, certifications, uptime status, and other trust signals, please visit our [HAAS Alert Trust Center](https://www.haasalert.com/trust-center "").
